deadlines.title: CAT 2026 Registration Close

deadlines.action: Verify MDU H+ institutional status and B.Tech CSE degree recognition on anabin.kmk.org; save PDF confirmation.

deadlines.title: IELTS Academic Booking Trigger (Backup Deadline)

deadlines.title: CAT 2026 Admit Card Release

deadlines.title: Passau Application Freeze & Submission Window
deadlines.action: Submit completed Passau M.Sc. CS application before 15 Nov freeze to preserve 100% mental stamina for CAT exam.

deadlines.title: CAT 2026 Examination Day
deadlines.action: National CAT exam: 68 questions in 120 minutes (VARC 24, DILR 22, QA 22). Report 1 hr before allocated slot.

deadlines.title: Passau Summer 2027 Buffer Close
deadlines.action: Final administrative buffer for tracking receipt and portal confirmation (Passau portal window 1 Nov - 15 Dec).

deadlines.title: CAT 2026 Official Scorecard & Results
deadlines.action: Download official CAT scorecard from iimcat.ac.in for DoMS IIT Delhi, IIT Madras, FMS, and CAP IIMs shortlists.
